P.name: Mark of the Kindred
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} Both '''Lamb''' and '''Wolf''' mark targets to ''hunt''. Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against a ''hunted'' target collects a stack of ''Mark of the Kindred''.

{{sbc|Mark of the Kindred:}} '''Lamb''' gains {{pp|type=marks|75;100;125;150;175;200;225;250|4;7;10;13;16;19;22;25|formula=+75 at 4 stacks, and +25 every 3 stacks thereafter, up to 250 bonus range at 25 stacks.}} {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} on her basic attacks and ''{{ai|Mounting Dread|Kindred}}''.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Lamb:}} '''Lamb''' is offered a selection of enemy {{tip|champions}} to ''hunt'' if she has not been [[combat status|in combat]] with them in the last 6 seconds. Once selected, the mark is applied after an 8-second delay and thereafter it can be collected by '''Kindred'''. '''Lamb''' gains the ability to select a new target every 75 seconds. ''Targets successfully hunted cannot be marked again for 4 minutes.''

Q.name: Dance of Arrows
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lamb''' {{tip|dashes}} toward the target location, gaining {{sti|attack speed|{{as|35%|attack speed}}}} {{as|(+ 5% per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|mark}})|buzzword}} {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} for 4 seconds and firing an arrow at up to 3 nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies that deals {{as|physical damage}}. Her current attack target within any proximity will be prioritized by one of the arrows.
Q.description2: ''Dance of Arrows' '' {{sti|'''total''' cooldown}} is reduced to an amount while '''Lamb''' is within the area of ''{{ai|Wolf's Frenzy|Kindred}}''. Casting ''{{ai|Wolf's Frenzy|Kindred}}'' reduces ''Dance of Arrows' '' '''current''' cooldown to the same amount.
Q.description3: ''Dance of Arrows {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Lamb's''' basic attack timer. '''Lamb''' can cast any of her [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''

W.name: Wolf's Frenzy
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Lamb''' generates 1 stack of ''Hunter's Vigor'' for every {{tt|27 units|Estimated}} she travels by any means and 5 stacks {{tip|on-attack}}, up to a maximum of 100 stacks. At maximum stacks, her next basic attack {{tip|heals}} her for {{as|{{pp|0 to 100 by 25|0 to 80|formula= 1.25% per 1% of '''Kindred's missing''' health. ''This is capped at 80% '''missing''' health.''|label1='''Missing''' health|type='''Kindred's''' '''missing''' health|label=Percent of level-scaling value|key=%|key1=%|changedisplay = true}}}} of {{pplevel|47 to 81|color=heal}}. The heal is not triggered if '''Kindred''' is at full health.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wolf''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location, then claims the surrounding area as his territory for the next {{fd|8.5}} seconds, separating from '''Lamb'''. He automatically attacks the closest nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy within the area, prioritizing the last enemy '''Lamb''' has attacked, then enemy champions, then non-champions.
W.description3: '''Wolf's''' attacks deal {{as|magic damage}} and the rate at which he attacks scale with {{as|25% of '''Kindred's bonus''' attack speed}}. Against monsters, his attacks deal 150% damage and {{tip|slow}} the target by 50% for 2 seconds. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at {{fd|112.5}} {{as|(+ 15 per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|mark}})|buzzword}} against monsters.
W.leveling3: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|25 to 45}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% {{as|(+ 1% per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|mark}})|buzzword}} of target's '''current''' health)}}|Monster Damage|{{ap|25*1.5 to 45*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*1.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*1.5}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1.5*1.5}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1*1.5}}% per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|mark}})|buzzword}} of target's '''current''' health)}}}}
W.description4: ''Wolf's Frenzy'' ends immediately if '''Lamb''' leaves the area or dies.

E.name: Mounting Dread
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lamb''' fires a shot at the target enemy that {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 30% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} for 1 second and marks them for 4 seconds. Her {{tip|basic attacks}} against the marked target each apply a {{tip|stack}}, refreshing the duration and stacking up to 3 times.
E.description2: The third stack directs '''Wolf''' to pounce on the target, consuming all stacks to deal {{as|'''additional''' physical damage|physical damage}}, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 50|critScaling=true}}.
E.leveling2: {{st|Additional Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 200}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 5% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.5}}% per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|Mark}})|buzzword}} of target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
E.description3: The damage based on the {{as|'''missing''' health}} ratio is capped at 200 against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.

R.name: Lamb's Respite
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lamb''' blesses the ground underneath herself, creating a sacred zone at the location that lasts for 4 seconds. {{tt|'''All''' units|Ally, enemy, and neutral}} inside the zone gain a {{tip|minimum health threshold}} equal to {{as|{{sti|health|10% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}, and will also become {{tip|invulnerable}} while remaining in the area when they reach or are at the threshold, during which they also cannot be {{tip|heal|healed}}, but can still {{sti|health regeneration|regenerate health|link=health regeneration}}.
R.description3: All targetable units within the zone are {{tip|heal|healed}} when the blessing ends.
R.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|160 to 120}}|Begins at start of cast time}}
